title.zh: 手机壳里的设置与手册面板又在了
title.en: The phone shell's settings and manual panels are back

highlights.zh: 手机壳的四个面板此前被放在两个分支各写一份；去重时误删了设置与手册两个，现已恢复为两个分支共用一个定义。
highlights.en: The shell's four panels used to be written once per branch; the dedup deleted the settings and manual ones, and both now render from one shared definition.

highlights.zh: 同时修正了验证口径：判断面板是否打开要看 [role=dialog]，而不是整页节点数（换了屏会让节点数持平）。
highlights.en: The verification metric was fixed too: a panel is open when [role=dialog] appears, not when the page's node count grows — a screen swap can keep it flat.

title.zh: 手机壳里点不动的入口全修好了
title.en: The phone shell's dead entries all work now

highlights.zh: 手机壳此前只收到三个属性：播放条打不开全屏播放器，更多里的设置/更新/手册/搜索四个入口点了没反应。现已接通整组属性。
highlights.en: The shell had been given only three props, so the bar could not open the full player and four entries under More did nothing; the whole contract is wired now.

highlights.zh: 首页搜索以前只管列表与计数、时间轴不动；现在时间轴也随搜索变短（159→17 时节点 11→4）。
highlights.en: Search used to narrow the list and its count while the timeline ignored it; the timeline shrinks too now (11 nodes to 4 when 159 genres become 17).

title.zh: 手机打开任何桌面地址都会进入 /m
title.en: A phone opening any desktop address lands in /m

highlights.zh: 以前只有 / 会被接管，手机从分享链接、书签或后退键进来仍停在桌面版；现在除 /m 外一律进入手机外壳。
highlights.en: Only the root used to be taken over, so a phone arriving from a share link, a bookmark or the back button stayed in the desktop layout; now every address except /m enters the phone shell.

highlights.zh: 并在跳转前一帧不渲染桌面界面，避免手机先看到用不了的布局；?desktop=1 可显式留在桌面版。
highlights.en: The desktop surface is not painted for the frame before the redirect, and ?desktop=1 keeps a phone on the desktop page on purpose.

title.zh: 全部 159 个曲风都有片段，渲染加了进程级看门狗
title.en: All 159 genres have a clip, and the renderer got a process-level watchdog

highlights.zh: 最后 4 个曲风补切完成（goa/vocal/euro/dream-trance，各 16.6 秒）⇒ 清单 159 条，159 个曲风一个不缺。
highlights.en: The last four genres are cut (goa, vocal, euro and dream trance, 16.6 s each), so the list holds 159 clips and no genre is missing.

highlights.zh: 渲染挂死时由进程组看门狗杀掉并继续下一个曲风；配可红判据：喂永不回答的子进程，1.5 秒被杀且下一任务照跑。
highlights.en: A wedged render is killed by a process-group watchdog and the batch carries on, with a criterion that feeds it a child which never answers.

title.zh: 手机端可读性与样式归属的小修
title.en: Small fixes for phone readability and style ownership

highlights.zh: 手机最暗的一层文字调亮：对底色从 3.95:1 提到 5.24:1，越过正文门槛。
highlights.en: The dimmest phone text is lighter: 3.95:1 became 5.24:1 on the page, clearing the body-text floor.

highlights.zh: 和弦页三处写死的灰改用本皮肤墨色；App 里手机壳的懒加载移到其它视图旁边。
highlights.en: Three hardcoded greys in the chords view use the skin's own ink, and the phone shell's lazy import sits with the other views in App.

title.zh: 手机版以 /m 子路径回来，并带上预生成的主题片段
title.en: The phone version returns at /m, with pre-cut theme clips

highlights.zh: 手机壳 40 个文件接回：/m 路由、皮肤独立样式域、44px 与对比度三组判据、换音源可试听。
highlights.en: Forty phone-shell files are back: the /m route, an independent skin domain, the 44 px and contrast criteria, and an audition in the instrument chooser.

highlights.zh: 155 个 15–30 秒片段，各用该曲风自己的音色，存 Cloudflare；生成时同时体检数据并把问题写进清单。
highlights.en: 155 clips of 15–30 s, each through its genre's own instruments and served from Cloudflare; generation audits the genre data and writes what it finds into the list.

highlights.zh: 导出不再沉默六秒：先说“正在准备乐器…”，首次反馈从 6.4 秒缩到 0.1 秒。
highlights.en: An export no longer begins with six silent seconds: it says "Preparing instruments…", moving first feedback from 6.4 s to 0.1 s.

title.zh: MCP 更好用：轨道数据、旋律落轨、冷启动有进度
title.en: MCP gets data, a melody track, and a cold start that speaks

highlights.zh: describe_arrangement 可以要 JSON 数据，trackId 不必再从散文里找。
highlights.en: describe_arrangement can answer as data, so a client need not read a track's id out of prose.

highlights.zh: 新增 melody_to_track：生成的旋律直接落到轨道，按十六分网格，不必手工拼 startBeats。
highlights.en: melody_to_track writes a generated melody onto a track on the sixteenth grid, so nobody zips four arrays by hand.

highlights.zh: 渲染冷启动先报进度；未知参数会被点名；响度报告自称是已提交基线。
highlights.en: A render announces its cold start, a tool names the arguments it never declared, and the loudness report says it is a committed baseline.

highlights.zh: 类型选择器加宽到显示完整名称；鼓轨说明用内置套鼓；压缩器降级提示只说一次。
highlights.en: The kind chooser is wide enough to name itself, a drum track explains its built-in kit, and the compressor's fallback is said once per reason.

title.zh: 音源 chip 只显示乐器名，术语改成人话
title.en: Instrument chips name the instrument, and its terms are readable

highlights.zh: 音源 chip 只显示乐器名（去掉库前缀），表头上被截断的那一截随之消失。
highlights.en: An instrument chip now shows the instrument's own name rather than its library's, and the truncation the header suffered is gone.

highlights.zh: 把库自带的术语翻成人话：arco→Bowed、pizz→Plucked、3vel→3 layers，映射类程序标明是键位映射。
highlights.en: The library's own terms are translated: arco becomes Bowed, pizz becomes Plucked, 3vel becomes 3 layers, and map programs are labelled as keyswitch maps.

highlights.zh: 查不出含义的词（three、six、basic、looped）保持原样——名字不凭空发明意思。
highlights.en: Words whose meaning the data does not show (three, six, basic, looped) are left exactly as the library writes them.

title.zh: 标识唯一化、重复控件与皮肤统一
title.en: Unique ids, a duplicate control removed, and one surface rule

highlights.zh: 轨道表头与列表不再共用同一批测试标识（一个标识对应一个元素），并删掉新手提示里与播放重复的按钮。
highlights.en: The track header and the list no longer share test ids, one id now means one element, and the hint's duplicate play button is gone.

highlights.zh: 导出菜单改用皮肤表面色，不再写死深色；悬停底色改用可编译的类——之前那批悬停其实一直没有生效。
highlights.en: The export menu uses the skin's surface instead of a hardcoded dark colour, and the hover tint uses a class Tailwind actually generates — the earlier hover never applied.

highlights.zh: 折叠的轨道列表与空状态不再像两个标题；播放读数改用正确单复数。
highlights.en: The collapsed track list reads as a control rather than a second heading, and the transport readout uses real plurals.

highlights.zh: 修复采样音符在实时播放被硬切的问题（离线一直是对的），虚拟键盘与编排播放不再有咔声。
highlights.en: A sampled note is no longer cut at its gate on the live paths — the offline sink was always right — so the keyboard and arrangement playback stop clicking.

title.zh: 音源面板可点、chip 可读、门禁与文案修复
title.en: A clickable instrument panel, a readable chip, and gate and copy fixes

highlights.zh: 音源选择面板改为浮动层并钳制进视口，选项不再被下方详情区盖住、可以点选。
highlights.en: The instrument panel is a floating layer clamped into the viewport, so its options are no longer covered by the detail area below.

highlights.zh: 音源 chip 桌面从 112×17 变为 152×28，手机从 10px 宽变为 104px，并可看到完整乐名。
highlights.en: The instrument chip grew from 112×17 to 152×28 on desktop and from 10px wide to 104px on a phone, with the full name on hover.

highlights.zh: 工具栏按钮有了悬停反馈；轨道 chip 的测试标识不再重复；播放提示改用正确单复数。
highlights.en: Toolbar buttons respond to hover, a track's chip no longer shares its test id with the header's copy, and the transport readout uses real plurals.

highlights.zh: 首次进入的音频门禁可点背景关闭，不再挡住新建工程的按钮；量化一词改用美式拼写。
highlights.en: The first-run audio gate closes when its backdrop is clicked, so it stops covering the Create button, and the quantize label is spelled the US way.
